title: Directed continuity for the canonical etale section cocone
statement: Let I be a nonempty directed preorder and R a scheme [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions]. Let B : I opposite -> R.Etale be a diagram of etale schemes [def-weil-pbc-etale-site], with qcqs stages and affine transitions. Let c be a limit cone of its underlying scheme diagram, and let p : c.pt -> R satisfy c_i followed by the structure map of B_i = p. For a sheaf H of sets [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaf-of-sets], let nu be a natural transformation from B opposite followed by H to the constant diagram with value (p inverse image H)(c.pt). Suppose each nu_i is the inverse-image adjunction unit [lem-weil-pbc-sets-etale-inverse-image-composition-units] followed by restriction along the pullback map with components c_i and the identity [def-pc-fibre-product]. Then the cocone determined by nu is a colimit. This is only the directed continuity and identification step, not the reindexing from a general cofiltered category.

source.place: Tags 09YQ (degree-zero continuity route for sets via 0EYL, 04HR and 09YN) and 03S2; as used in Tag 03Q9

proof.text: Choose i0 by nonemptiness. Let D be the underlying scheme diagram, G the inverse image of H at i0, and W0 its terminal etale object. Transfer the given qcqs and affine-transition instances to D, and use the qcqs identity morphism for W0. Apply etaleSetSectionContinuity to obtain E, its object isomorphisms e, the cocone mu, its transition and component equations, and bijectivity of its colimit comparison.

Apply directedEtaleSectionIdentifications to obtain stage isomorphisms a and a vertex isomorphism l together with their transition and cone-component equations. Compose e_j with a_j inverse to get a natural isomorphism alpha from E to the original section diagram restricted by T = (Over.forget (op i0)).op. Naturality follows by cancellation of a_k, the transition equation, and the equation for E.

The bijective Type-valued colimit comparison is an isomorphism, hence mu is colimiting by IsColimit.ofPointIso. The vertex isomorphism l and the component equations give an isomorphism from the cocone kappa precomposed by alpha.hom to mu. Transport the colimit with IsColimit.ofIsoColimit and precomposeHomEquiv.

The underlying index category is cofiltered because I is directed. Mathlib Over.initial_forget makes Over.forget (op i0) initial; its opposite T is final. Functor.Final.isColimitWhiskerEquiv transports the colimit of kappa back to Cocone.mk nu.

proof_origin.place: Tags 09YQ and 03S2: unchanged directed continuity/comparison/cofinality route, with step 3 isolated as a cone-level identification theorem and categorical transport written in Lean.
